remarks: Beautifully designed and move-in ready, this elegant & modern End Unit townhouse has been thoughtfully customized for effortless living. Sun-filled sightlines flow from front to back, showcasing gleaming floors, large windows, & a bright, airy ambiance throughout. Every detail has been curated with intention, including modernized baths, customized closets, designer area carpets, drapery & hardware throughout, offering true turnkey living. The chef's eat-in kitchen is functional & sophisticated, with a large center island, ample seating, & premium finishes. The living room is anchored by a sleek gas fireplace with a striking stone facade & opens seamlessly to a private balcony, creating a refined, inviting space for everyday living and entertaining, while a chic powder room completes the main level. The serene primary suite impresses with vaulted ceilings, a skylight, & 2 spacious closets, while the second bedroom is equally generous & complemented by a stylish hall bath. The upper level has a versatile den ideal for a home office, playroom, or addl bedroom, with a large walk-in closet & ample storage. The walk-out lower level to the garage features a media, playroom or gym, along with new washer/dryer. A deep one-car garage provides multiple generous closets and great storage. Ideally located close to shopping, the Merritt Parkway, and just 3 miles to downtown Stamford, this home delivers beauty, ease, & elegance. Unpack and Enjoy Today! More pics & video soon
